entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You don't need to be here right[n]now, do you? Come on, let's head[n]somewhere else!
entries.uk: Тобі ж тут зараз нічого робити, так?[n]Ходімо кудись в інше місце!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's wrong? Come on, we should[n]go say goodbye to the others!
entries.uk: Що таке? Ну ж бо, треба піти[n]попрощатися з рештою!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It looks like we can't go past here...
This area is off-limits...
This is the guys' bathroom...
It seems even dirtier than the[n]ones in the classroom building...
entries.uk: Тут, здається, ще брудніше,[n]ніж у навчальному корпусі...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't you know that's the girls'[n]bathroom? You're not supposed[n]to be in there...
entries.uk: Ти що, не знаєш, що це жіночий[n]туалет? Тобі туди не можна...

entries.en: I don't have a good reason[n]to be in the ladies' restroom...
entries.uk: У мене немає поважної причини[n]заходити до жіночого туалету...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There are portraits covering the walls[n]in there... b-b-but they all have such[n]scary faces...
entries.uk: Там усі стіни в портретах...[n]Т-т-тільки обличчя в них[n]якісь моторошні...

entries.en: Portraits of famous composers[n]line the wall of the room...
entries.uk: На стіні кімнати висять у ряд[n]портрети відомих композиторів...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There are a lot of computers in there,[n]but not many students.
entries.uk: Комп'ютерів там багато,[n]а от учнів — не дуже.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess the computers themselves are pretty[n]outdated, so nobody wants to use[n]them anymore...
entries.uk: Мабуть, самі комп'ютери добряче[n]застаріли, от ніхто й не хоче[n]ними користуватися...

entries.en: I don't see any students in here...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wow, they're studying so quietly...
The students in here are all[n]studying diligently...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: "The Anguished Spirit"... "The Monster[n]Within"... These are all so edgy...
The room is decorated by various[n]student-made works of calligraphy.
It says it's under maintenance.[n]I don't think it's turned on...
entries.uk: Написано, що він на техобслуговуванні.[n]Не думаю, що він увімкнений...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is this a storage room? It looks like[n]it's locked.
The storage room is locked.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The storage room is locked.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hold on, we should use the main[n]entrance if you wanna go outside.

entries.en: There's no reason for me[n]to use the emergency exit...

entries.en: Shouldn't people be taking better care[n]of these? They'll end up getting damaged[n]out here.

entries.en: Some musical instruments have[n]been carelessly left out here...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So this is called a mouse? Don't worry,[n]I'm not gonna attack it.

entries.en: Somebody left a computer here for[n]some reason. Maybe it's broken...
